**Command**, from the repository root at the commit above:

```sh
./gradlew :rig:run --args="--brain shatterfish --seeds holdout --cap 20000 --out <dir> --registration H-0009-shatterfish-holdout-e7-confirmation"
```

Salts are drawn when each Run executes (ADR-0007), so the command reproduces the distribution, not these Runs; a Run itself is replayed from its log with `--replay`, and its salt and chain are in the committed index.

Pages this one depends on: [the statistic](../methodology.md#comparing-two-brains), [the Run log and its chain](../methodology.md#the-run-log-and-its-chain), [the mix](../methodology.md#the-mix), and [how to read this page](../methodology.md#results-pages).
